title: Strength in Unity: Climate Action for the Pacific Islands
summary_en: Pacific Island countries have turned collective diplomacy into global climate influence—but there are limits to this approach without greater global support.
title_cn: Strength in Unity: Climate Action for the Pacific Islands

title: Decoding the Right-to-Repair Debate
summary_en: The right-to-repair debate, concerning who controls U.S. defense IP, has become a contentious issue in defense acquisition policy. Lawmakers need to balance the military’s push for greater access to technical data and industry’s fear of losing revenue and IP control.
